# Southerleigh Fine Food & Brewery

> Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Gumbo, snapper throats and fried chicken, with beer brewed on site in the historic Pearl brewhouse.

- Phone: (210) 455-5701
- Address: 136 E Grayson St Suite 120, San Antonio, TX 78215
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Coastal classics; Southern comfort; Brewed on site
- Rating: 4.5 from 4379 Google reviews
